access.how: A Claude Pro or Max subscription (claude.ai), or an API key from console.anthropic.com

settings.title: Permission mode
settings.explain: How much Claude Code may do without asking. It can be changed for one session with Shift+Tab.

choices.label: Ask first
choices.explain: Asks before it edits a file or runs a command.

choices.label: Plan only
choices.explain: Reads and plans; changes nothing until you agree.

choices.label: Only what is allowed
choices.explain: Never asks: does only what your allow rules permit and refuses the rest.

choices.label: Edit without asking
choices.explain: Edits files in the project on its own, asks before commands.

choices.label: Automatic review
choices.explain: A classifier lets safe actions through and asks about the rest.

choices.label: Bypass all checks
choices.explain: Does everything without asking. Only for a throwaway machine.

settings.title: Sandbox for commands
settings.explain: Runs shell commands in a sandbox (bubblewrap on Linux): writes only in the project, network only to allowed sites.

choices.label: Off
choices.explain: Commands run with all your rights.

settings.title: Block bypass mode
settings.explain: Makes it impossible to start Claude Code with --dangerously-skip-permissions, even by mistake.

choices.label: Blocked
choices.explain: Bypass mode cannot be switched on.

choices.label: Allowed
choices.explain: Bypass mode can be switched on with a flag.

sessions.note: Numbers from Claude Code's session files (no text is read). The API value is what the tokens would cost at API prices, not what a plan costs.
